title: [4.5] Inherited scenes issues
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in v4.5.stable.official [876b29033]


### System information

Godot v4.5.stable - Windows 10 - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+)

### Issue description

I have tried to add and remove back and forth script from the scene that other scenes inherits. It ends up by not updating all inherited scenes that are added in other scenes. Maybe I am just doing it wrong or understanding badly, sorry to bother.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/9ced1ac9-bbf2-406f-a931-a2ec1768f8fb

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create scene "cat"
2. Create new inherited scene named "orange_cat"
3. Add "orange cat to main scene"
5. Edit "cat", add script with basic line to print "hello cat", save 
6. Go back to main scene, script icon is not seen in "orange_cat"
7. Run main scene, it prints "hello orangecat", close
8. Add second "orange_cat2" to the scene
9. Run main scene. Now it prints only "hello orangecat2"
10. Close and open main scene again, script icon shows only at "orange_cat2", prints only "hello orange_cat2"
11. Close entire project, open again, nothing chaned. Only one cat has script.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[4.5-test.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/22369263/4.5-test.zip)
